resources.string: Light guard active · daily auto scan
Periodic light scans to detect and alert about suspicious apps

Performs periodic light scans of your phone, identifying suspicious apps based on permission combinations and behavior patterns, and alerts you the moment malware is found. No special permissions required.
Requests accessibility permission for deep scans and direct handling
After granting Android accessibility permission, Polaris can run deeper scans (including accessibility-service abuse detection) and attempt to directly deal with obvious malware.
Requests Shizuku permission for deep scans and early blocking
Uses Shizuku permission for even deeper scans, and can intercept malware before it starts running.
Uses Root permission for all-round blocking and guarding
Directly uses the phone\'s Root permission for all-round interception and guarding: freeze malicious apps and block their auto-start and execution.
Polaris uses this service to monitor foreground app changes and detect malware in Accessibility mode. Polaris never collects or uploads any personal data.

· Scan Center: folder scan / full scan
· Quarantine: quarantine · restore · allow management
· API Key stored with Keystore encryption
· Appearance themes (dark / light / follow system) and in-app language switching

· New "Intercept" guard tab (red alert theme)
· Real-time blocking of malicious lock-screen / screen takeover / notification theft / ransomware / usage-rights violations
· Pinned system notification "Intercept mode on" when enabled, one-tap to turn off
· Blocked apps managed centrally, with allow and delete
· AI scan shows the full reasoning feedback
